_about: Answer key for the TM470 vulnerability-tool evaluation.
cvss_source: NVD v3.x base score via vulnreport.nvd.client.get_cvss

targets.note: Path traversal / RCE. Exploitable only in certain configurations, so matching on version alone over-flags. Included to expose that limit in the precison figure.
Backdoored build. Nmap reads the version cleanly.
SambaCry. Read the exact version from the scan. Nmap often reports a Samba version range rather than a pinned number, which is worth recording as a matching limitation.
Username enumeration, OpenSSH <= 7.7. The one mid-severity target, so it gives MAE and RMSE some spread.

Resolver off-by-one. Only exploitable when the resolver directive is figured, so like CVE-2021-41773 it is config-dependent and version-only matching can over-flag. Confirm the version against the scanned image. Gives the HIGH-band point for MAE/RMSE spread.
Patched release. The tool should NOT flag CVE-2021-41773 or CVE-2021-42013 here. Provides true negatives for precision and recall.
